rules.title: Approved Components Should Be Used Where Available
rules.summary: Screens should prefer approved design-system components over ad hoc raw primitives when a known component family exists for the interaction.
signals: raw button or input primitives in a screen module
hand-built action affordances instead of approved components
screen-level component composition bypasses the local component layer

rules.title: Visual Values Should Use Tokens
rules.summary: When frontend code carries explicit visual values, spacing and colour should use token-like references rather than bespoke hard-coded values.
signals: visual style literals with no token marker

rules.title: Interactive Elements Should Advertise State
rules.summary: Action elements should expose disabled, busy, or loading markers when the workflow can pause or submit work.
signals: clickable control has no disabled marker
busy action has no loading or aria-busy marker
submit action has no state-carrying attribute

patterns.title: Table Screen Pattern
patterns.summary: Use when a screen presents a list or table with explicit actions, stable spacing, and token-backed visual primitives.

patterns.title: Form Screen Pattern
patterns.summary: Use when a screen presents form actions, token-backed visual values, and explicit disabled or busy states on primary actions.
